The '''Healing Chambers''' within the [[XoXaan's Temple]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] were used by the [[One Sith]] as of [[137 ABY]]. It was here that [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Hand (One Sith)|Hands]], [[Darth Stryfe]] and [[Darth Talon]], were placed in [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] [[Bacta tank/Legends|tanks]] after their defeat at the [[Battle on Had Abbadon]].
